scope.limits: Scripted paid policies are not human play or optimality claims. No combat tuning, free buildings, HP/gold edits, synthetic troops, or automatic wins. Seed is the only initial battle override. Trace hashes sample before each one-second decision and at the exact end, not every simulation tick. Current progression and optional flight examples also use playable save roundtrips. Terminal states use raw engine hashes because the playable codec intentionally rejects ended battles. No browser, physical-device, performance, network, deployment or live-release certification. Historical identity compatibility is covered separately by existing frozen-oracle/identity tests.
